graph.name: EARTH2 deep dive 2: the food collision
graph.schema: Graphify v5 (NetworkX node-link: nodes and links)
graph.board_refs_note: Taken from graph.json odds_now on Nov 23, 2026 (not older board snapshots).
graph.strength_rule: strength = (odds of B if A fires - odds of B now) / (100 - odds of A now), absolute value, capped at 1. NECESSARY links use B now / A now (deep dive 1 rule: if A fails, B falls to about zero).
graph.company_link_rule: Company links use kind MAGNIFIES and sign +1 to mean the node moves the stock. Direction is not labeled. Strength is an estimated exposure weight.
graph.options_rule: US-listed options from the OCC series search (standard product symbol only). Liquidity by total open interest, same bands as graph.json options_check: heavy 1,000,000+, moderate 100,000+, light 10,000+, very light under 10,000.
graph.arm_note: Three arms: EL NINO (graph arm WEATHER AND FOOD), GULF FERTILIZER (graph arm OIL AND GULF) and RUSSIAN GRAIN AND FERTILIZER (graph arm RUSSIA AND EUROPE). Graph node WF4 (Gulf fertilizer) sits in WEATHER AND FOOD on the graph; this file reads it as the Gulf arm for the 3-node, 2-arm company flag.

WF7 and WF8 (food price layer): EL NINO via WF2, FD20, WF3

collision_verdict.tightest_overlap: 2027-02-01 to 2027-03-31 (Gulf peak, Russian quota and port season, India rice decision ahead of state elections); the vegetable oil leg peaks later, Apr to May 2027.

graph.not_advice: Not financial advice. No tickets, no orders.

nodes.label: El Nino crop losses locked in for H1 2027: the Jan 12, 2027 WASDE still puts India's 2026-27 rice crop below 2025-26 (Nov: 147.0 vs 154.0 Mt) and GAPKI still sees lower Indonesian palm oil output in 2027 than 2026 (59.87 vs about 61.8 Mt).
nodes.least_capability: None. Already in the forecasts, and the El Nino is in the ocean (CPC Nov 12: Nino-3.4 at +2.5C).
nodes.settlement_test: El Nino crop losses locked in for H1 2027: the Jan 12, 2027 WASDE still puts India's 2026-27 rice crop below 2025-26 (Nov: 147.0 vs 154.0 Mt) and GAPKI still sees lower Indonesian palm oil output in 2027 than 2026 (59.87 vs about 61.8 Mt).
nodes.current_fact: USDA WASDE Nov 2026: India rice 147.0 Mt in 2026-27 vs 154.0 Mt in 2025-26. GAPKI Nov 16, 2026: Indonesia CPO plus PKO 59.87 Mt in 2027, down 3.1%; El Nino costs about 3.08 Mt.

nodes.label: Indonesia tightens palm oil exports by Jun 30, 2027: raises the export levy above 12.5% of the reference price, raises the domestic market obligation, or caps export permits.
nodes.least_capability: A trade or finance ministry regulation. B50 pulls about 17.4 Mt of CPO into biodiesel in 2027 (GAPKI) while El Nino cuts output.
nodes.settlement_test: Indonesia tightens palm oil exports by Jun 30, 2027: raises the export levy above 12.5% of the reference price, raises the domestic market obligation, or caps export permits.
nodes.current_fact: Nov 2026: CPO reference price $978.90/t; export duty $124/t; levy 12.5% ($122.36/t); combined $246.36/t, down from $308.27/t in October. GAPKI sees 2027 exports at 29.73 Mt, down 12.3%.

nodes.label: India bans exports of non-basmati white rice outright (as on Jul 20, 2023) by Jun 30, 2027. This alone settles WF8 (a top-3 exporter bans a staple's main grade).
nodes.least_capability: One DGFT notification. The Feb to Mar 2027 state elections (Uttar Pradesh, Punjab and three more) give the motive; record state stocks are the brake.
nodes.settlement_test: India bans exports of non-basmati white rice outright (as on Jul 20, 2023) by Jun 30, 2027. This alone settles WF8 (a top-3 exporter bans a staple's main grade).
nodes.current_fact: Nov 5, 2026 (Platts): no new curbs; the government is weighing a curb on 100% broken rice; broken rice $336/t FOB, up 5% in a month. USDA Nov: India ships 23.0 Mt of 60.2 Mt world rice trade in 2026-27 (38%) and ends the year with 58.0 Mt of stocks.

nodes.label: Indonesia bans palm oil exports outright (as on Apr 28, 2022) by Jun 30, 2027. This alone settles WF8.
nodes.least_capability: A presidential announcement after a domestic cooking oil price spike, as in April 2022.
nodes.settlement_test: Indonesia bans palm oil exports outright (as on Apr 28, 2022) by Jun 30, 2027. This alone settles WF8.
nodes.current_fact: Nov 23, 2026: Malaysian palm oil futures RM4,157/t, an eight-month low, down 13% in a month; Malaysian stocks a record 3.62 Mt in October. GAPKI: Indonesian 2027 exports down 12%.

nodes.label: India's Feb to Mar 2027 state elections go ahead: Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Uttarakhand, Goa and Manipur (Election Commission dates expected in January 2027).
nodes.least_capability: Calendar. The assemblies' terms run out in spring 2027 [exact dates unverified].
nodes.settlement_test: India's Feb to Mar 2027 state elections go ahead: Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Uttarakhand, Goa and Manipur (Election Commission dates expected in January 2027).
nodes.current_fact: Nov 2026 press: the Election Commission is expected to announce dates for the five states in January 2027; polls likely in February and March.

nodes.label: No bypass at scale for Gulf fertilizer: overland trucking to Saudi Red Sea ports and other workarounds carry less than a quarter of the Gulf's pre-war fertilizer exports in every month through Mar 2027.
nodes.least_capability: None. True today: Saudi trucking volumes are too small to replace the strait (The National, Oct 31).
nodes.settlement_test: No bypass at scale for Gulf fertilizer: overland trucking to Saudi Red Sea ports and other workarounds carry less than a quarter of the Gulf's pre-war fertilizer exports in every month through Mar 2027.
nodes.current_fact: Sep 2026 Middle East fertilizer exports 994,000 t vs 3.41 Mt a year earlier (Kpler via The National). All Saudi ammonia exits through Hormuz; Ma'aden idled two of its three 1.1 Mt a year ammonia units in March (Argus, Nov 9).

nodes.label: Sulfur stays short and phosphate output stays cut: Mosaic's Q4 2026 report (due late Feb 2027) still lists its Louisiana phosphate plants (Uncle Sam, Faustina) idled or curtailed.
nodes.least_capability: Sulfur stays near or above $1,000/t; about half of traded sulfur comes from Hormuz-exposed countries (TFI).
nodes.settlement_test: Sulfur stays short and phosphate output stays cut: Mosaic's Q4 2026 report (due late Feb 2027) still lists its Louisiana phosphate plants (Uncle Sam, Faustina) idled or curtailed.
nodes.current_fact: Oct 29, 2026: Uncle Sam and Faustina idled or curtailed; Bartow, New Wales and South Pierce at reduced rates; Brazil sites idled. Spot sulfur topped $1,000/t this year with peaks near $1,300 (vs about $500 in January). Mosaic Q3 phosphate operating loss $194M (Nov 3).

nodes.label: China opens a 2027 urea export quota of 3 Mt or more, announced by Apr 30, 2027 (2026: 3.3 Mt, opened in late May with FOB floors of $430 to $500/t).
nodes.least_capability: A customs and NDRC quota notice.
nodes.settlement_test: China opens a 2027 urea export quota of 3 Mt or more, announced by Apr 30, 2027 (2026: 3.3 Mt, opened in late May with FOB floors of $430 to $500/t).
nodes.current_fact: CF (Nov 4, 2026): China is expected to export 2 to 4 Mt more urea than last year but to keep control of nitrogen exports for food security. China's MAP and DAP exports remain tightly controlled (Oct 29).

nodes.label: US spring nitrogen squeeze: DTN's weekly US retail urea average tops $750 per ton in any week from Jan 1 to May 31, 2027 (Nov 9 to 13, 2026: $657).
nodes.least_capability: Hormuz stays shut into Northern Hemisphere spring buying while Europe stays gas-short.
nodes.settlement_test: US spring nitrogen squeeze: DTN's weekly US retail urea average tops $750 per ton in any week from Jan 1 to May 31, 2027 (Nov 9 to 13, 2026: $657).
nodes.current_fact: DTN Nov 9 to 13, 2026: urea $657/t (up 10% on the year), anhydrous $997 (up 16%), DAP $947, MAP $995, potash $504.

nodes.label: Tampa ammonia monthly contract settles at $750/t or higher for any month from January to May 2027 (November 2026 about $640, derived).
nodes.least_capability: Europe keeps curtailing on gas while Gulf ammonia stays stuck behind Hormuz.
nodes.settlement_test: Tampa ammonia monthly contract settles at $750/t or higher for any month from January to May 2027 (November 2026 about $640, derived).
nodes.current_fact: November 2026 settled up $95/t from October (Yara and Mosaic, Oct 28). September was $555 and October fell $10, so November is about $640 (derived). Q3 2026 average $622, up 27% on the year (LSB).

nodes.label: Europe stays gas-short for ammonia: the TTF front month settles above EUR 80/MWh on 20 or more trading days from Jan 1 to Mar 31, 2027.
nodes.least_capability: QatarEnergy's force majeure stays in place through a normal winter (EU storage just under 75% full on Oct 28).
nodes.settlement_test: Europe stays gas-short for ammonia: the TTF front month settles above EUR 80/MWh on 20 or more trading days from Jan 1 to Mar 31, 2027.
nodes.current_fact: TTF settled above EUR 100/MWh on Oct 28, 2026, the first time since Dec 2022 and about 3x pre-war. CF: 37% of Europe's ammonia capacity was offline or cut in October. Yara cut 150,000 t of ammonia in Q3.

nodes.label: Egypt keeps rationing gas to fertilizer plants: cuts of 20% or more are still in force on Feb 28, 2027 (33% since Nov 8, 2026).
nodes.least_capability: Costly spot LNG (JKM above $34/MMBtu at end October; close to $120M a cargo).
nodes.settlement_test: Egypt keeps rationing gas to fertilizer plants: cuts of 20% or more are still in force on Feb 28, 2027 (33% since Nov 8, 2026).
nodes.current_fact: Nov 8, 2026: cuts raised to 33% (MOPCO filing); Abu Qir and Kima confirmed the 20% cut of Nov 1; no end date. Egypt makes about 6.5 Mt of urea a year and exports about 3.6 Mt; granular about $535/t FOB, up 17% since September.

nodes.label: US farmers cut corn for 2027: USDA Prospective Plantings (Mar 31, 2027) puts corn below 93.0 million acres (2026: 96.8 million).
nodes.least_capability: High nitrogen prices against corn prices tilt acres to soybeans; no new event needed.
nodes.settlement_test: US farmers cut corn for 2027: USDA Prospective Plantings (Mar 31, 2027) puts corn below 93.0 million acres (2026: 96.8 million).
nodes.current_fact: USDA Nov 2026: US corn planted 96.8 M acres in 2026 vs 98.7 M in 2025. Kpler: the US would have planted more corn in 2026 had urea been cheaper.

nodes.label: A Ukrainian strike halts a major Russian nitrogen plant (Nevinnomyssk Azot, Novomoskovsk Azot, Acron Novgorod, Dorogobuzh, KuibyshevAzot or Togliattiazot) for 2 weeks or more between Dec 1, 2026 and Jun 30, 2027.
nodes.least_capability: Long-range drones already used on these plants (Acron Jan 2026, Dorogobuzh Feb 2026, Nevinnomyssk Azot).
nodes.settlement_test: A Ukrainian strike halts a major Russian nitrogen plant (Nevinnomyssk Azot, Novomoskovsk Azot, Acron Novgorod, Dorogobuzh, KuibyshevAzot or Togliattiazot) for 2 weeks or more between Dec 1, 2026 and Jun 30, 2027.
nodes.current_fact: Jan 2026 drone attack on Acron; Feb 2026 FP-1 strike on the Dorogobuzh plant (Smolensk) with deaths; strikes on Nevinnomyssk Azot. CF (Nov 4): the war is a risk to Russian nitrogen sites. Russia exported about 43 Mt of fertilizer in 2025. Outage lengths [unverified].

nodes.label: Russia tightens fertilizer exports beyond its Dec 2026 to May 2027 quota (18.8 Mt): cuts the quota, or suspends ammonium nitrate or urea exports, by May 31, 2027.
nodes.least_capability: A government decree. Russia suspended ammonium nitrate exports for a month in spring 2026 and moved to quotas on Apr 22.
nodes.settlement_test: Russia tightens fertilizer exports beyond its Dec 2026 to May 2027 quota (18.8 Mt): cuts the quota, or suspends ammonium nitrate or urea exports, by May 31, 2027.
nodes.current_fact: Nov 6, 2026: quota for Dec 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027 over 18.8 Mt (nitrogen over 11.3 Mt including 2.3 Mt ammonium nitrate; complex over 7.5 Mt). Domestic prices up more than 30% in 2026 (Aug 3).

nodes.label: Russia sets its Feb 15 to Jun 30, 2027 grain export quota at 12 Mt or less (2026: 20 Mt for wheat, meslin, barley and corn combined).
nodes.least_capability: A government resolution, usually issued in late December.
nodes.settlement_test: Russia sets its Feb 15 to Jun 30, 2027 grain export quota at 12 Mt or less (2026: 20 Mt for wheat, meslin, barley and corn combined).
nodes.current_fact: Aug 2026: Russia weighing 2027 quotas on corn and barley of 3 to 5 Mt; corn stocks about 0.2 Mt. USDA Nov: Russian 2026-27 wheat crop 88.0 Mt, exports 39.0 Mt (cut from 40.0).

nodes.label: Novorossiysk is hit again: a strike halts two or more Novorossiysk grain terminals for 7 days or more between Dec 1, 2026 and Jun 30, 2027.
nodes.least_capability: Sea and air drones already in use (Aug 2026: three terminals shut; five grain ships hit Aug 17 to 18).
nodes.settlement_test: Novorossiysk is hit again: a strike halts two or more Novorossiysk grain terminals for 7 days or more between Dec 1, 2026 and Jun 30, 2027.
nodes.current_fact: Aug 2026: three Novorossiysk deep-sea terminals shut after attacks; five grain ships hit near Novorossiysk and Tuapse on Aug 17 to 18; shipowners avoiding Russian ports; August wheat exports 1.8 Mt vs 4.5 Mt a year earlier.

nodes.label: Russia's southern grain route stays impaired: Azov Sea and Black Sea grain loadings stay well below normal through Mar 31, 2027 (Azov halted since July 2026; Azov ports carry about a quarter of Russian grain exports).
nodes.least_capability: None new. Drone risk and insurance already keep ships away.
nodes.settlement_test: Russia's southern grain route stays impaired: Azov Sea and Black Sea grain loadings stay well below normal through Mar 31, 2027 (Azov halted since July 2026; Azov ports carry about a quarter of Russian grain exports).
nodes.current_fact: Aug 20, 2026: Azov ports halted since July. Oct 1: SovEcon cut its season forecast to 36.7 Mt; Azov and Black Sea shipments well below normal; Novorossiysk and Tuapse at reduced capacity; no normalization expected before 2027. Status since October [unverified].

nodes.label: Food prices turn up: the FAO Food Price Index prints above 133.9 (its October 2026 level) in at least one month from November 2026 to June 2027.
nodes.least_capability: Any one arm biting; sugar has already risen four months running.
nodes.settlement_test: Food prices turn up: the FAO Food Price Index prints above 133.9 (its October 2026 level) in at least one month from November 2026 to June 2027.
nodes.current_fact: Oct 2026 index 133.9, down 1.6 points; cereals down 4.5%, vegetable oils up 0.3%, sugar up 6.6% (FAO, Nov 6). Next release about Dec 4.

nodes.label: Vegetable oils lead the turn: the FAO Vegetable Oil Price Index rises 15% or more above its October 2026 level in any month by June 2027.
nodes.least_capability: El Nino yield losses reach Indonesia from Q1 2027 while B50 absorbs supply.
nodes.settlement_test: Vegetable oils lead the turn: the FAO Vegetable Oil Price Index rises 15% or more above its October 2026 level in any month by June 2027.
nodes.current_fact: Palm oil RM4,157/t on Nov 23, 2026, down 13% in a month; Malaysian stocks a record 3.62 Mt in October. FAO vegetable oils up 0.3% in October.

nodes.label: The grain cushion holds: USDA's Feb 10, 2027 WASDE keeps 2026-27 world wheat ending stocks at 275 Mt or more (Nov 2026: 280.8 Mt).
nodes.least_capability: Nothing has to happen; stocks are already high.
nodes.settlement_test: The grain cushion holds: USDA's Feb 10, 2027 WASDE keeps 2026-27 world wheat ending stocks at 275 Mt or more (Nov 2026: 280.8 Mt).
nodes.current_fact: USDA Nov 2026: world wheat ending stocks 280.8 Mt (Oct 276.0). AMIS Nov 10: 360.6 Mt, up from 346 Mt. FAO: cereal stocks-to-use 32.4% (Nov 6).

nodes.label: THE FOOD COLLISION LANDS IN H1 2027: by Jun 30, 2027 all three hold: (1) WF4 settles true (Gulf fertilizer exports under half of 2025 in every month through March); (2) Russian wheat exports for Jul 2026 to May 2027 total under 34 Mt (on pace for RU9); (3) India restricts a non-basmati rice export (WF3) or Indonesia tightens palm oil exports (FD02).
nodes.least_capability: No new event: today's Gulf and Russian conditions persist while one government notice lands.
nodes.source: graph.json odds_now (WF4, RU9, WF3) ; this file (FD02)
nodes.settlement_test: THE FOOD COLLISION LANDS IN H1 2027: by Jun 30, 2027 all three hold: (1) WF4 settles true (Gulf fertilizer exports under half of 2025 in every month through March); (2) Russian wheat exports for Jul 2026 to May 2027 total under 34 Mt (on pace for RU9); (3) India restricts a non-basmati rice export (WF3) or Indonesia tightens palm oil exports (FD02).
nodes.current_fact: Graph odds Nov 23: WF4 75, RU9 62, WF3 50; this deep dive: FD02 35. Joint, treating the arms as independent: 0.75 x 0.62 x 0.58 = about 27%.
